intro.uz: Bu — Kamolaning blogi. U sevimli mashgʻuloti haqida yozadi. Oʻqishdan oldin: sizning xobbingiz nima?

paragraphs.en: Hi, everyone! I'm Kamola, and this is my blog. I am fourteen and I live in Samarkand. Today I want to tell you about my hobby. My hobby is drawing.
paragraphs.uz: Hammaga salom! Men Kamolaman, bu esa mening blogim. Men oʻn toʻrt yoshdaman va Samarqandda yashayman. Bugun sizga xobbim haqida aytib bermoqchiman. Mening xobbim — rasm chizish.

paragraphs.en: I draw every day after school. I usually draw people, cats and old buildings. Samarkand has many beautiful buildings, so I never get bored!
paragraphs.uz: Men har kuni darsdan keyin rasm chizaman. Odatda odamlar, mushuklar va qadimiy binolarni chizaman. Samarqandda goʻzal binolar koʻp, shuning uchun hech qachon zerikmayman!

paragraphs.en: I have a big box of pencils and a small sketchbook. I always carry my sketchbook in my bag. On Saturdays I go to an art club. Our teacher is very friendly.
paragraphs.uz: Menda bir katta quti qalam va kichkina eskiz daftari bor. Eskiz daftarimni doim sumkamda olib yuraman. Shanba kunlari rasm toʻgaragiga boraman. Oʻqituvchimiz juda samimiy.

paragraphs.en: I also like reading and playing chess with my grandfather, but drawing is my favourite. What is your hobby? Write in the comments!
paragraphs.uz: Men kitob oʻqishni va bobom bilan shaxmat oʻynashni ham yoqtiraman, lekin eng sevimli mashgʻulotim — rasm chizish. Sizning xobbingiz nima? Izohlarda yozing!
